scripts.setup:
echo '
=== LINKEDIN CARGOS SCRAPER SETUP ===

1. Copy the environment template:
   cp env-template.txt .env

2. Edit .env file with your API keys:
   - APIFY_API_TOKEN: Get from https://console.apify.com/account/integrations
   - HUBSPOT_API_KEY: Get from https://app.hubspot.com/settings/api
   - CLICKUP_API_TOKEN: Get from https://app.clickup.com/settings/apps

3. Configure extraction limits (optional):
   - MAX_RESULTS_PER_SEARCH: Perfiles por búsqueda (default: 10)
   - MAX_COMPANIES_PER_RUN: Empresas por ejecución (default: 50)
   - SEARCH_DELAY_MS: Delay entre búsquedas (default: 2000ms)

4. Run the scraper:
   npm start

5. Or run scheduler:
   npm run scheduler
'
